metadata.title: CNCF Source Repository — Shared Base Component Definition

components.title: CNCF Source Repository
components.description: Shared component representing any CNCF source repository. Defines rules, check types, and default parameter values for all controls selected by the cncf-repo profile. Per-project component definitions import this base and override only the parameters that differ from these defaults.
components.purpose: Provide a reusable compliance baseline for CNCF source repositories.

control-implementations.description: Shared implementation of cncf-repo profile controls for all CNCF source repositories.
